purpose: Resolve only file/schema parsing details needed to construct the response-blind phase-1 confirmatory geometry. This rule may inspect taxonomy, FASTA headers, accession membership and coordinates, but never nucleotide characters.

locus_identifier_normalization.step_1: uppercase and trim the raw genes.txt gene field
locus_identifier_normalization.step_2: replace every run of underscore, hyphen or whitespace by one ASCII space
locus_identifier_normalization.step_3: normalize the canonical species name by the same rule
locus_identifier_normalization.step_4: if and only if the normalized gene identifier begins with '<normalized species> ', remove that prefix once
locus_identifier_normalization.step_5: compare the remaining token by exact equality to the parent protocol COI-family normalized aliases
locus_identifier_normalization.forbidden: substring, regex-near-match, edit-distance or post-download manual locus relabeling

aligned_file_resolution.candidate: within that directory, the aligned .afa file whose extension-free basename equals the raw genes.txt gene field exactly
aligned_file_resolution.fallback: if no exact basename exists, STOP that genes.txt row as unresolved; do not guess among files

header_only_fasta_read.allowed: read only lines beginning with '>' and strip the leading character plus surrounding whitespace
header_only_fasta_read.forbidden: reading, hashing, counting, validating or otherwise inspecting any non-header FASTA line during phase 1
header_only_fasta_read.occurrence_join_key: prefer exact phylogatr_id match; if no phylogatr_id match for a header, permit exact accession match only when accession is non-empty and unique in occurrences.txt; otherwise the sequence has no usable locality

coordinates.parse: finite decimal latitude and longitude only
